title: Bethe Hessian Recovery through the Kesten-Stigum Regime
abstract: arXiv:2610.41802v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We show that outlier eigenvectors of the Bethe Hessian achieve weak recovery in the stochastic block model down to the Kesten-Stigum threshold, for every fixed common expected degree $d>1$. This extends previous recovery guarantees, which required $d$ to be sufficiently large. This threshold is information-theoretically optimal for the symmetric two-community model and is conjectured to mark the limit of efficient recovery in broader symmetric models. Our result matches the recovery guarantees of non-backtracking spectral methods while using Hermitian $n\times n$ matrices.   To do this, we identify recursive formulas for the negative outlier eigenvalues and show that their eigenspaces have nonvanishing overlap with the corresponding planted eigenspaces. translated_title: 跨越 Kesten-Stigum 区域的 Bethe Hessian 恢复
translated_abstract: 我们证明，对于每个固定的公共期望度 $d>1$，Bethe Hessian 的离群特征向量在随机块模型中能够实现弱恢复，直至 Kesten-Stigum 阈值。这扩展了以往需要 $d$ 足够大的恢复保证。该阈值在对称双社区模型中是信息论意义上最优的，并被推测标志着更广泛对称模型中高效恢复能力的极限。我们的结果在使用厄米特（Hermitian）$n\times n$ 矩阵的同时，达到了与非回溯谱方法相当的恢复保证。为此，我们给出了负离群特征值的递归公式，并证明这些特征空间与相应的种植特征空间之间存在非零的重叠。证明过程通过在极限泊松树上利用种植标签构造近似特征向量（其权重由格林函数给出），并将这些近似结果转移至……
tldr: 本文证明对于任意固定期望度 d>1 的随机块模型，Bethe Hessian 的离群特征向量都能实现直至信息论最优的 Kesten-Stigum 阈值的弱恢复，仅用厄米特矩阵即匹配了非回溯谱方法的恢复保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that outlier eigenvectors of the Bethe Hessian achieve weak recovery down to the information-theoretically optimal Kesten-Stigum threshold for the stochastic block model with any fixed expected degree d>1, matching non-backtracking spectral guarantees using Hermitian matrices.
